description: Check an IP against abuse.ch's Feodo Tracker botnet command-and-control blocklist (keyless): a hit means the IP is a known C2 server for a malware family (Emotet, Dridex, QakBot, TrickBot, …), with the malware name, port and first-seen date. For a host name the first resolved IP is used. Threat-intel about the IP — never touches the target. Read-only.

target.description: IP address or host name, e.g. 45.83.66.10 or example.com

name: feodo_c2_check
